mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CART (USER_ID, REG_ID, PEOPLE_CNT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{regId}, #{peopleCnt})
mapper.select: SELECT ct.USER_ID, ct.REG_ID, ct.PEOPLE_CNT, r.REG_TITLE, r.REG_PRICE, r.START_DT, r.END_DT, c.CTRY_NAME, l.LOC_NAME, i.IMG_PATH, i.ORIGIN_NAME FROM CART ct JOIN REGISTER_PROD r ON r.REG_ID = ct.REG_ID JOIN PACKAGES p ON p.PACKAGE_ID = r.PACKAGE_ID JOIN LOCATION l ON l.LOC_ID = p.LOC_ID JOIN COUNTRY c ON c.CTRY_ID = p.CTRY_ID LEFT JOIN IMG_MAPPING m ON m.REG_ID = r.REG_ID AND m.VIEW_SEQUENCE = ( SELECT MIN(m2.VIEW_SEQUENCE) FROM IMG_MAPPING m2 WHERE m2.REG_ID = r.REG_ID ) LEFT JOIN IMG_STORAGE i ON i.IMG_NO = m.IMG_NO WHERE ct.USER_ID = #{value}
